citation: Luo Q., Hariri F., Eloussi L., Marinov D. An Empirical Analysis of Flaky Tests
focus: Flaky-test causes, fixes and failure manifestation
method: Mining and manual inspection of 201 likely flaky-test-fixing commits from 51 Apache projects
